faq.q: Which Cloverdale areas appear on this page?
faq.a: The listings we checked were labelled Cloverdale BC (custom detached houses) and Clayton (two parcels framed as development opportunities) — feed labels only, not a price claim about any sub-area.

faq.q: Is there extra property transfer tax on a home over $3 million?
faq.a: Yes. The Province applies a further 2% tax to the residential property value greater than $3,000,000, on top of the general tiers (1% to $200,000, 2% to $2,000,000, 3% above $2,000,000); on a mixed-class property the further 2% applies only to the residential portion.

faq.q: Does the first-time buyer exemption or the new-home exemption help at $1.8M?
faq.a: No. The first time home buyers' program full exemption caps at a fair market value of $835,000, and the newly built home exemption is fully eliminated at $1,150,000 — both far below this band, so a buyer here budgets full property transfer tax.

faq.q: What are the house size limits on ALR land in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Under the ALC housing rules, an ALR parcel may have one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha), with any secondary suite inside the principal residence; ALR status is parcel-specific, so check the parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission's maps before relying on those limits.
